description: This file contains two value converter classes for a UWP application, converting boolean values to Visibility states and their negations.

classes.name: BooleanToVisibilityConverter
classes.description: Converts a boolean value to Visibility.Visible or Visibility.Collapsed.

classes.name: BooleanToVisibilityNegationConverter
classes.description: Converts a boolean value to the negation of Visibility.Visible or Visibility.Collapsed.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a boolean to Visibility (Visible or Collapsed).

methods.name: ConvertBack
methods.description: Converts Visibility back to a boolean value.
